properties.note: Mercer County's 24 precincts are the Census 2020 voting districts, which carry the county's own 24 precinct names 24/24 and sum to its exact 2020 population. Each feature also carries its County Board district, which is whole-precinct — no precinct is split between districts. Polling places are not shown here: nothing the county publishes pairs its precincts with buildings as data.
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts dissolved per the composition of Mercer County's certified 17 March 2026 General Primary results, published as structured data by County Clerk & Recorder Brian Gerber's own results system
